boulders.name: The McNugget
boulders.approach: Up the hill from the warmups about 50 yards, the good climbs face up hill.

boulders.name: Rex Kwon Do Boulder

boulders.name: Psyche Transfer

boulders.name: Walkabout 4

boulders.name: Warmup Boulders

boulders.name: Form Destroyer Roof Boulder

boulders.name: Luminance Block
boulders.approach: Park at the Beehive parking and walk in between the domes as for the rest of The Beehive climbs. While walking towards Secrets of the Beehive or The Swarm/ Brown Wall Boulder, this boulder will be located down a deep…

boulders.name: The Flake Crack Boulder
boulders.approach: Just left of the boulder at the base of the Secrets Boulder (the middle boulder)

boulders.name: Natural Melody Boulder
boulders.approach: After entering the cave, to left around the Nectar Boulder until the obvious scoops.

boulders.name: Queen Sweet Nectar Boulder
boulders.approach: Secrets of the Beehive Area

boulders.name: Secrets of the Beehive Boulder
boulders.approach: Secrets of the Beehive area

boulders.name: Bachar Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up the hill from the lower parking area past the Grandma Peabody and up to the right towards the east side of the Drifter/Smoking boulders.

boulders.name: Birthday Boulders
boulders.approach: From Buttermilk Road, drive up the hill with the boulders on your right, go over a cattle guard and make an immediate right. Take your next right into the parking area/loop. The Birthday Boulders are the closest to the…

boulders.name: Bowling Pin Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulders parking area, traverse the hillside eastwards for 100+ yards. It's just uphill from the Tut Boulder. The boulder is easily spotted when viewed from the east.

boulders.name: Boy and Girl Rocks
boulders.approach: From the parking loop in the Buttermilks Main Area, follow the marked trail above Birthday Boulders past Loaf (on left), to Pope's Hat (on left). Boy and Girl rocks are on your right, immediately downhill of Pope's Hat.…

boulders.name: Buttermilk Stem Boulder
boulders.approach: Rowell Rocks Area, just uphill from Rowell Rock, on the main path that runs east/west across the hillside.

boulders.name: Pothole Boulder
boulders.approach: 30 feet east of Rowell Rock

boulders.name: Rowell Rock
boulders.approach: Just downhill from the 'Buttermilk Stem Boulder', 30 feet West of the 'Pothole Boulder'. This is the largest boulder in the group.

boulders.name: Buttermilks Dome
boulders.approach: walk around or scramble behind iron man

boulders.name: Buttocks/Smooth Shrimp Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk a short distance Northwest from the Pope's Prow/Mandala Boulder

boulders.name: Cave Boulder
boulders.approach: Cave Area of the Buttermilks.

boulders.name: Robinson's Rubber Tester Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder down hill from 'Soul Slinger'.

boulders.name: Soul Slinger Boulder
boulders.approach: Small boulder just northeast of the Cave Boulder.

boulders.name: Corner Boulders
boulders.approach: Between the Petroglyph Boulder and the Tut Boulder. The cluster of boulders just down slope and southwest of the Tut Boulder.

boulders.name: Drifter/Smoking Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up hill from the Peabody Boulders.

boulders.name: Fit Homeless Boulder
boulders.approach: From The Cave Area , head up the slope, passing Soul Slinger to reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Green Wall Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area for the Peabody Boulders, head up the main trail passing the Peabodies to your right. The Green Wall Boulder is up on the left above the Sunshine Boulder. Look for the beautiful north face with the…

boulders.name: Grovel Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Iron Man Boulder, walk downhill and southeast about 20 yards. Grovel Roof will be on your left on the steepest side of the boulder facing downhill (south).

boulders.name: The Hunk
boulders.approach: From the Green Wall Boulder, look uphill and to the right: the boulder is pretty big and tough to miss. The boulder problem 'The Hunk' is on the right side of the north (uphill) face.

boulders.name: Hero Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulders parking area, walk east about 50 yards past the Pope's Hat Boulder and Boy and Girl Rocks until you reach the overhanging face on your right. The trail goes directly under 'Hero Roof'.

boulders.name: Iron Man Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk past the 'Hero Roof Boulder' and it'll be up on your left about 30 feet.

boulders.name: The Golden Boulder
boulders.approach: If you are looking at the "Iron Man Traverse", look off to your right and you will see a very large boulder with a unique crack system near the bottom of it. There is also a smaller boulder which is adjacent to a long…

boulders.name: Hager Boulder
boulders.approach: 30 yards up and to the east of the Iron Man Boulder

boulders.name: The Loaf
boulders.approach: Just north of Birthday Boulders near the main parking area.

boulders.name: Lower Smoking Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk around the backside of The Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Mandala/Pope's Prow Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk uphill from the Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Mini Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike to High Plains Drifter. From there it is directly east of the Womb boulder.

boulders.name: Never Trust a Man-Bun Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike to the girl rock routes and turn around.

boulders.name: Grandma Peabody Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the parking lot.

boulders.name: Grandpa Peabody Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Peabody parking area (lower parking), open your eyes

boulders.name: Peewee Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk toward Grandpa Peabody, but head to the little boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Pinch Boulder
boulders.approach: Park for the Peabodies and hike uphill past Highplains before heading east.

boulders.name: Pope's Hat
boulders.approach: Walk east, passing the south end of The Loaf to this boulder.

boulders.name: Ranger Rock
boulders.approach: Walk east from the west parking area.

boulders.name: Roadside Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area follow the path up and left directly towards the boulder.

boulders.name: Scoop Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area walk up and leftwards towards the boulders.

boulders.name: Saigon Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Peabody Parking Area, walk up the main trail past the Green Wall Boulder. From here the Saigon Boulder can be seen as the highest boulder on the hill. The route 'Saigon' will be the gently overhanging…

boulders.name: Sharma Traverse Boulder
boulders.approach: Directly uphill from Smooth Shrimp and Mandala

boulders.name: Stained Glass/Flyboy Area
boulders.approach: From the Birthday Boulder parking area, head north up the hill, left and behind the Birthday Boulders and up past The Loaf.

boulders.name: Sunshine Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike uphill to the northwest from the Peabodys.

boulders.name: Tut Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder is situated below the Bowling Pin Boulder , just south of the East / West path.

boulders.name: Twins Boulders
boulders.approach: From the Iron Man Boulder, walk downhill and southeast about 40 yards, past Grovel Roof

boulders.name: Upside Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk uphill 5 minutes from the Saigon Boulder.

boulders.name: Womb Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk about 50' NNE from The Drifter Boulder.

boulders.name: Beyond the Edge of Reason Boulder
path: Beyond the Edge of Reason Boulder
boulders.approach: Head uphill from either Checkerboard or Edge of Reason. It looks like a little loaf, but the east side holds a proud problem. About five minutes of uphill sand and your're there.

boulders.name: The Checkerboard Boulder
boulders.approach: Checkerboard Area

boulders.name: Chess Boulder
boulders.approach: Checkerboard area of the Buttermilks.

boulders.name: Edge of Reason Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Checkerboard Boulder hike down into the deep ravine and up the other side. This boulder is the next one visible.

boulders.name: The Knight Boulder
boulders.approach: In the Checkerboard area.

boulders.name: Overseer Boulders
boulders.approach: Hike straight up the hill from The Checkerboard to the small cluster of large boulders on the very top of the hillside.

boulders.name: The A-Team Boulders
boulders.approach: The approach is easy, as these boulders are some of the most Northern rocks in Dale's Camp. Just walk slightly Northeast of the Small Fruit Boulders, or Southwest of the Heart Prow Boulder.

boulders.name: Green Hornet Boulder
boulders.approach: A couple hundred yards or so west of Dale's Dome in the trees.

boulders.name: Zen Flute Boulder
boulders.approach: 75 yards downhill and to the northwest of the 'Green Hornet Boulder'. 'Zen Flute' v10 faces uphill towards 'Green Hornet' (the first problem you see).

boulders.name: Girls of Whiskey Creek Boulder
boulders.approach: In the Hueco Roof Area of Dale's Camp. If you are going toward Xavier's Roof, it is just below downhill.

boulders.name: Hueco Wall Boulder
boulders.approach: Hueco Wall area of Dale's Camp.

boulders.name: Swiss Roof Boulder

boulders.name: Xav's Roof Boulder
boulders.approach: In the Hueco Wall area of Dale's Camp.

boulders.name: Fear Of A Black Planet Boulder

boulders.approach: Just next to Small Fruit boulder.

boulders.name: Small Fruit Boulder
boulders.approach: Just next to Fear of a Black Planet Boulder.

boulders.name: Agent Orange Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach just as you would for the Hearts Prow or Zeppelin Area.

boulders.name: Chicken Head Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach just as you would for Heart Prow or Zeppelin Area.

boulders.name: Cuban Roll Boulder

boulders.name: The Ghost of Dale Bard
boulders.approach: Just uphill from the Led Zeppelin Boulder.

boulders.name: Heart Prow Boulder
boulders.approach: From Zeppelin, hike around the hill to the northeast.

boulders.name: Led Zeppelin Boulder
boulders.approach: If walking up past the 'Cuban Roll Boulder', head up the hill and slightly right maybe 30 yards. There's a smaller, flatter boulder touching it on the right side ('Little Zeppelin Boulder').

boulders.name: Get Carter Boulder
boulders.approach: Drive past the Birthday Boulders parking lot and turn right. Follow this down the hill until you see the boulder on the right, 10 feet off the road.

boulders.name: The Glass House
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the parking

boulders.name: The Green Room
boulders.approach: Up the hill from the Glass House, in a little corridor.

boulders.name: Snake Eyes Boulder
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the parking, down and left from the Glass House

boulders.name: Hall of Mirrors

boulders.name: Cracked Boulder
boulders.approach: Just west of the Orange Slab

boulders.name: Creek Boulder
boulders.approach: At the waterfall, cross the creek to the obvious boulder on the other side.

boulders.name: Iron Woman
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the Orange Slab

boulders.name: The Mustache Ride
boulders.approach: Towards the west end of the boulders, look for a lip traverse that is shaped like a Mustache

boulders.name: The Orange Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the warmup block and the Whale boulder

boulders.name: The Pit Boulder
boulders.approach: Just up the hill from the orange slab.

boulders.name: Tang

boulders.name: Whale Boulder
boulders.approach: Just off the trail, obvious

boulders.name: Honey Bear Bong Boulder
boulders.approach: 25 feet uphill from the Apiary Boulder.

boulders.name: Beekeeper Boulder

boulders.name: Cracked Cobble Boulder
boulders.approach: Continue walking uphill and west from the Beekeeper area another couple hundred feet to reach this cluster of hidden boulders at the col.

boulders.name: The Hive Boulder
boulders.approach: Continue uphill from the Apiary boulders 1 min.

boulders.name: Honey Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk to The Lidija Boulder then head south to the next boulder.

boulders.name: Jedi Boulder
boulders.approach: Just down the hill from the Lidja boulder

boulders.name: Lidija / Pollen Grain Boulder

boulders.name: Mead Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk west from Spectre.

boulders.name: The Ninth Boulder
boulders.approach: Slog your way up the hill. There does not appear to be any distinct trails or an easy way up.

boulders.name: Spectre Boulder

boulders.name: White Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach from the Apiary/Hive boulders. 2-5 mins uphill. The Ninth is clearly visible from White Slab.

boulders.name: Possibly Disasterous

boulders.name: The Sexy Bloc

boulders.name: Sherman Acres

boulders.name: Boneyard Area
boulders.approach: Walk as for the Painted Cave area, but keep following the path which leads towards the distant Grouse Mountain. Grouse Mountain appears in between two pillar like rock formations. This is also the way to get to…

boulders.name: Charlie Brown Boulders
boulders.approach: From Painted Cave walk west towards a boulder cluster.Hard to miss the prominent horizontal cracks and the two touching large boulders.

boulders.name: Slashface Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is kind of hidden from view due to a large rock formation seen from the trail. Best way to get to it is to go down the sandy slab going southwest so you can come up to the northside of the boulder.

boulders.name: Xen Boulder
boulders.approach: As for "Painted Cave", but while looking at the problem turn around and look in the distance and slightly right. There is a run-off/ drainage scoop with some boulders in it. This boulder lies slightly uphill from there.…

boulders.name: Solitaire Boulder
boulders.approach: Just before the cattle guard before the Birthday boulders parking, turn left and park at the end of the road. Cross the creek and head up the other side. Hang a left through a small wash, then start to your right…

boulders.name: Arch Drude Boulder
boulders.approach: Take a left off the main trail onto the approach trail. Walk past the 'Sacrificial Boulder Area', then head left (north) down the slope. Look for the overhanging west face.

boulders.name: Finland Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is at the center of the area.

boulders.name: Finlandia Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is at the center of the area.

boulders.name: Granitic Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk west from the center of the area for about 30 yards.

boulders.name: Puberty Boulder
boulders.approach: From "Arch Drude" spin around and walk towards the Granitic Boulder. This boulder is about a hundred yards from "Arch Drude", but slightly over the crest of a hill.

boulders.name: Blood Kin Stone
boulders.approach: From the Thunder Wall, walk just uphill toward the Druid Stone. The face of this boulder that faces the Thunder boulder has two curious huecos that look like owl's eyes. Just northeast of the Druid Stone.

boulders.name: Golden Child Wall
boulders.approach: This wall is located west of the central area and easily seen as you approach from the path.

boulders.name: Ice Flow
boulders.approach: From the cave walk east and clamber of rocks to reach the enclosed area.

boulders.name: Land of the Lost
boulders.approach: Top of the trail before summit, look left.

boulders.name: Odin's Cave
boulders.approach: From the west head towards [108592867]] and at its right end, duck down and head left. The wall is on your left as you enter the 'cave'.

boulders.name: Helluland
boulders.approach: It is located in the middle of the area.

boulders.name: MIssack
boulders.approach: Walk east form the main area and slightly south and you'll come to this boulder.

boulders.name: William The Vollman
boulders.approach: This large boulder is easily recognized on the west side of the area.

boulders.name: Wimmin Cave
boulders.approach: Walk east form the central area and look out for the hueco'd north east face.

boulders.name: Blakkr Boulder
boulders.approach: Once in the area locate the bigger Norse Boulder and this boulder is located 5 yards to the north.

boulders.name: Erik the Bolder
boulders.approach: Walk past the horizontal bowling pin boulder and the trail-side junk boulders and this boulder will be on your left about 15 yards away.

boulders.name: Junk in your Trunk
boulders.approach: Walk about 20 yards south of the Long Ship Boulder.

boulders.name: The Long Ship
boulders.approach: From the trail in, as you walk towards the popular Sacrificial Boulder, the Long Ship will be off to your left.

boulders.name: Norse Boulder
boulders.approach: Lies at the south side of the area.

boulders.name: Eyes Boulder
boulders.approach: Located on the far east side of the area, the west wall is easily identified by it's rich patina features.

boulders.name: Hall of the Mountain Queens
boulders.approach: From the main area head downhill trending rightwards. At the large dead tree continue on for another 100 yards to reach this boulder.

boulders.name: Izzy Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main area head downhill passed the large dead tree. Walk 30 yards more and turn right. You will see the boulder nestled next to smaller boulders.

boulders.name: Leaning Tower Boulder
boulders.approach: From Hall of the Mountain Queens walk east a few yards.

boulders.name: Morning Glory Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main area head downhill and trend right, towards a large dead tree. This boulder is soon seen 30 yards beyond the tree.

boulders.name: Outer Banks Boulder
boulders.approach: Located south east of the Queens boulder look for the slab downhill face.

boulders.name: Patina Slab
boulders.approach: Head south from Hall of the Mountain Queens for 30 yards.

boulders.name: What's The Story Boulder
boulders.approach: From Morning Glory Boulder this boulder is located a few yards east.

boulders.name: Sacrificial Boulder
boulders.approach: After turning left off the main trail, it's the first major cluster of good-sized boulders. It will be on your right off the side trail amongst 2 or 3 other boulders with a pine tree on either end of the oval-shaped…

boulders.name: Shock Therapy Boulder
boulders.approach: From the "Thunder Wall Boulder" spin around and go directly down the hill about 25 yards. Go around the left side and you will see "Lizard Therapy" and "Lounge Lizards"

boulders.name: All Fired Up Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk east from Skye Stone for about 20 yards.

boulders.name: Skye Stone
boulders.approach: Walk east past the 'Thunder Wall' and you'll see the obvious boulder in the near distance.

boulders.name: White Man's Overbite Boulder
boulders.approach: From "Skye Dance" , walk rightwards around the boulder towards "Cayla" , and this boulder is seen touching the Skye Stone.

boulders.name: Goblin Rock
boulders.approach: Situated in the south west section of the area.

boulders.name: Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: Lies to the right of Thunder Wall Boulder .

boulders.name: Thunder Wall Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow the trail around the left side of the Druid Stone until you see the long overhanging orange patina wall facing north.

boulders.name: Trailside Boulder
boulders.approach: About halfway between the parking lot and main area. Easily seen from the trail.

boulders.name: Kojak Boulder
boulders.approach: Can be seen a stone throw downhill from the Wave Boulder.

boulders.name: Wave Boulder
boulders.approach: Around the corner from the 'Skye Stone'. You can't miss the the scooped out 'wave'-like wall.

boulders.name: Wicca Tower
boulders.approach: Walk north for about 40 yards from the Kojak Boulder down a slight slope.

boulders.name: Hurd Lake

boulders.name: Keough Boulder
boulders.approach: On the right side of the road as you enter the resort. Look for the flag pole.

boulders.name: Fire on the Mountain Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as you would for little egypt. Walk left past the Frontier. This boulder is located just left of the Lambada Dome

boulders.name: Not My Chair Boulder
boulders.approach: From Bishop, follow Highway 168 past the Buttermilks turn-off. The highway has a large S-curve that you will drive along. Once you pass this, the highway begins straightening out again, and you'll see the large boulder…

boulders.name: Pyramid Problems
boulders.approach: 10 minutes from the frontier. Take a left to go East as if you were going towards Lambada dome, but keep going left instead of hooking back right. The problems are both on the backsides of the boulders.

boulders.name: The Fantasy
boulders.approach: The Fantasy is located between the Delta and Mungie walls, near the end of the canyon. There are two approaches. If the pullouts along Pine Creek Road are snowed in, approach exactly as for the Delta Wall, but once you…

boulders.name: Red Cross Boulder
boulders.approach: Park infront of the red cross and its right there... There is another short boulder up canyon that's less than 10' tall, that's not it. The Red Cross Boulder has a high point roughly 20' tall.

boulders.name: Rolling Stone Boulder
boulders.approach: Drive past the Scheelite Canyon parking area. As soon as you cross a bridge over Pine Creek, the boulder will be on your immediate left and clearly visible from the road. Park along the side here and enjoy the…

boulders.name: Hungry Packer Lake Boulders
boulders.approach: About a 7 mile approach to Hungry Packer Lake, a great place to explore if you're already backpacking. As you approach the lake, the boulder field is on the left side. 37.1587° N, 118.6447° W

boulders.name: Lake Side Rock
boulders.approach: Go down to the boat launch its the 16ft Arrowhead shaped rock on the water.

boulders.name: Sabrina Dives
boulders.approach: Access is by boat, kayak or SUP only. Launch from the main boat ramp and paddle to the far side of the lake.

boulders.name: Spillway Boulder
boulders.approach: Park as you would for the Sabrina Trail and follow the trail for a minute or two until you see the boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Trailside Boulder
boulders.approach: Park at Sabrina Lake Trailhead and follow the trail for a couple of minutes. It is 30 yards past Spillway Boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Roadside Fire Boulder
boulders.approach: Park in a dirt pullout just past the boulder on the east side of the road and then make a short walk from the parking down a trail on the north side of the parking to the obvious boulder.

boulders.name: Hole In One Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area, head east up the first "step," and there is a large square-shaped boulder.

boulders.name: Happy Boulder
boulders.approach: Central canyon, 30 feet past the Solarium Boulder , dead ahead.

boulders.name: Heavenly Path Boulder
boulders.approach: Central canyon, the obvious large clean-cut boulder on the right (east) side of the trail, 20 feet down-canyon from the 'More Water, Less Power Boulder'.

boulders.name: Jolly Beggar Boulder
boulders.approach: The next boulder past/behind the Solarium boulder if walking up canyon

boulders.name: More Water, Less Power Boulder
boulders.approach: About 20 feet from the 'Heavenly Path Boulder', just up-canyon.

boulders.name: Solarium Boulder
boulders.approach: Just past (up-canyon) from the 'Heavenly Path Boulder' and 'More Water, Less Power Boulder'. The 'Solarium Boulder' hugs the right (east) side of the trail 30 feet down-canyon from the 'Happy Boulder'.

boulders.name: Window Boulder
boulders.approach: Just west of More Water Less Power

boulders.name: Cleopatra Area
boulders.approach: Hike up canyon to the last area in the guidebook, Top Gun. Hike up to the West rim and look for the tall rounded prow between two other boulders.

boulders.name: Action Figure Cave
boulders.approach: From the path leading up the slop keep heading towards the rim, until the cave can be seen on your left as you approach the rim.

boulders.name: Back Walls
boulders.approach: Walk up the path from the canyon towards the rim. You'll pass the cave first on your left then be in a open area looking at the back walls.

boulders.name: Little Country Girl Alcove
boulders.approach: From the Split Melon Area turn back to the right and head up to the rim. Or from Action Figure walk left along the wall and snake between a few boulders back out to the rim.

boulders.name: One Note Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up to the area from the canyon, this boulder is on the leftside as you approach the alcove.

boulders.name: Atari Area
boulders.approach: The area can either approached from either the approach trail, or more commonly from a trail up from the Slow Dance Cave .

boulders.name: Black Magic Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the center canyon towards the East rim. This boulder is the first smooth wall you'll see.

boulders.name: Blood Simple Wall
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon passing Black Magic Boulder as you reach the rim you'll see the steep pockets wall.

boulders.name: California Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up to the rim and walk leftwards until you reach this boulder.

boulders.name: California Rim Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up to the rim from the canyon and walk leftwards to the obvious deep alcove. This boulder lies at its mouth.

boulders.name: California Wall
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon towards the rim and walk leftwards until you see the problem.

boulders.name: Californication Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up to the rim from the canyon floor and head left along the rim until you reach this boulder.

boulders.name: Coen Brothers Boulder
boulders.approach: Once at the Blood Simple Wall turn around and you are facing boulder. Walk around left to find the problems.

boulders.name: Flying Saucer Alcove
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon, passing the Blood Simple Wall , and keeping left head up to the rim. The alcove is soon reached.

boulders.name: Flying Saucer Rock
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon passing Blood Simple Wall on your left and continue into the alcove at the rim. The rock is on your right.

boulders.name: Rio Rose Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up to the area from the canyon floor. This boulder lies on the right side of the area.

boulders.name: Water Saps Cave
boulders.approach: Hike up the trail to the rim and walk along the edge until the cave is reached.

boulders.name: Baby Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon towards the rim, and this boulder is facing you as you approach the rim.

boulders.name: Chocolate Slab
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon towards the rim. Before reaching the rim you'll come to this distinct boulder.

boulders.name: The Cracks On The Rim Left Side
path: The Cracks On The Rim Left Side
boulders.approach: Walk up towards the rim from the canyon. As the boulders approach shuffle left then continue into the bay at the rim.

boulders.name: The Cracks On The Rim Right Side
path: The Cracks On The Rim Right Side
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon towards the rim. This section is the right side of the area.

boulders.name: Marvelous Flake Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon towards the rim and trend right as you approach the rim, the marvelous flake will be seen on the south facing wall.

boulders.name: The Uncracked Wall
boulders.approach: Walk up to the east rim from the canyon. This area is recognized by the black streaked wall.

boulders.name: Unnamed Boulder
boulders.approach: At the Slow Dance area head up east toward the canyon rim. Please use established trails.

boulders.name: Wiggler Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up from the canyon. As the rim is approached head north to reach this boulder.

boulders.name: Offwidth Area
boulders.approach: From the main trail head toward the east rim from the More Water Less Power area. The Heavenly Path boulder is a good landmark for where to head east. Please use established trails to prevent further damage to the…

boulders.name: The Citadel Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Slight Inducement boulder look for an established trail that heads northeast to the canyon rim. If you reach the Cry Baby boulder you've gone too far north.

boulders.name: Secret Arete Boulder
boulders.approach: The Secret Arete boulder is tucked away on the rim of the canyon just east of Shadow Play. From the side the boulder is dagger shaped. Please use established trails to help prevent further damage to the fragile desert…

boulders.name: Shadow Play Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Happy Boulder hike up the east rim trail to reach the rim. The boulder is easily seen just a little down on the left.

boulders.name: Sixty Foot Woman Wall
boulders.approach: From the central happy's, head up and right to reach this wall.

boulders.name: Take it Like A Man Boulder
path: Take it Like A Man Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder sits just east of You Are Mortal Buttress. Please use established trails.

boulders.name: You Are Mortal Buttress
boulders.approach: Once you reach Slight Inducement Boulder via the main trail look for established trails leading east. Please use existing trails to avoid further damage to the desert environment.

boulders.name: Trombone Area
boulders.approach: Walk past the 'Happy Boulder Area' to the next obvious cluster found just off the trail on the right side.

boulders.name: Hard Crack Area
boulders.approach: Instead of turning into the canyon, go straight up. East of Atari.

boulders.name: Anti Chrysler Boulder
boulders.approach: Take a right when walking up trail when you see the face of Jesus Chrysler.

boulders.name: Dusty Cave
boulders.approach: Visible to the right off the main trail!

boulders.name: Get Around Boulder
boulders.approach: Head slightly north east from the Jesus Chrysler Boulder.

boulders.name: Headbangers Cave
boulders.approach: From the parking lot hike up the trail and shortly after passing the Jesus Chrysler Boulder as the trail levels out make a right and follow a trail into the alcove.

boulders.name: Jesus Chrysler Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up the trail until it levels off. The first boulder with chalk on it is this boulder.

boulders.name: Superstar Boulder
boulders.approach: In the jesus chrysler area, past zero and before the turn to headbangers cave

boulders.name: Zero Boulder
boulders.approach: This is the boulder right next to the Zero Roof Cave. If you are looking East at Ain't But The One Way v0+ this is the bigger boulder directly North of you.

boulders.name: Zero Cave
boulders.approach: This is a small boulder right past the Jesus Chrysler boulder. If you are looking at the backside for the Jesus Chrysler Boulder (Ain't But The One Way v0+) turn around and it will be right in front of you.

boulders.name: Fred Boulder
boulders.approach: From Savannah Boulder continue up the canyon 10 yards. Fred Boulder is on your right.

boulders.name: Girlfriend Rock
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon from the Central Happiness Area , this boulder is the first you'll encounter on the left of the path.

boulders.name: Please, Please Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon from the Central Happiness Area , this boulder is the first you'll encounter on the right of the path.

boulders.name: Savannah Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up the trail from the 'Girlfriend Boulder'. This boulder is the first large, obvious boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Bleached Bones Boulder
boulders.approach: Facing up the canyon this boulder lies a few yards to the right of the Serengeti Boulder .

boulders.name: Chimpanzee Boulder
boulders.approach: From Serengeti Boulder head left up slope more or less at 90 degrees to the main trail. The buttress is easily recognized by its undercut front face, and steep smooth right side.

boulders.name: Cilley Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Serengeti Boulder look right and you'll see it.

boulders.name: Crispin Waddy Alcove
boulders.approach: From Serengeti Boulder walk left up the slope for about 30 yards directly into the alcove.

boulders.name: Giggle, Giggle Boulder
boulders.approach: From Serengeti head up and around to the right of the Bleached Bones and Cilley boulders. The cave faces down hill so you will be looking up into it.

boulders.name: Karma Alcove
boulders.approach: Walk past the Serengeti Boulder and turn right up the hill behind the Soweto Boulder. Look for a nook with a nice overhanging flat prow.

boulders.name: Serengeti Boulder
boulders.approach: It lies in the middle of the canyon, and can't be missed.

boulders.name: Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: When you are facing up canyon towards Serengeti Boulder this boulder sits about 40feet to the left of Serengeti Boulder .

boulders.name: Soweto Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Serengeti Boulder head up rightwards to reach this boulder.

boulders.name: Blight Induced Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up passed the Serengeti Area and this boulder is located just right of the Slight Inducement Boulder .

boulders.name: The Citadel
boulders.approach: Walk up to the east rim above the Cry Baby Boulder and then go right.

boulders.name: Cry Baby Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk 50 yards up and to the right from Slight Inducement Boulder .

boulders.name: Cry Baby Buttress
boulders.approach: Located on the right side of valley left of the Cry Baby Boulder .

boulders.name: Less Of An Inducement Boulder
boulders.approach: Located 20 yards farther up the canyon from the Slight Inducement Boulder .

boulders.name: Slight Inducement Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike up passed the Serengeti Area and this boulder is easily recognized on the right.

boulders.name: Stimulus Boulder
boulders.approach: Across the canyon and uphill from the Slight Inducement Boulder

boulders.name: Acid Wash Cave
boulders.approach: Around on the up-canyon side of the Slow Dance Cave is the Acid Wash Cave

boulders.name: Corner Boulder
boulders.approach: Just east and up-slope of the 'Slow Dance Cave'. The west face offers the good stuff.

boulders.name: Corridor Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the trail, when you reach the top of the initial hill it will be right in front of you.

boulders.name: Gleaner Boulder
boulders.approach: Just up-canyon from the Slow Dance Cave. It will be to your right off the main trail, down the hill a short distance. The overhanging side faces up-canyon and is visible from the main trail.

boulders.name: Monkey Hang Boulder
boulders.approach: Just east of the 'Slow Dance Cave', the boulder with the big roof/overhang at about face-level.

boulders.name: Prow Boulder
boulders.approach: Just before the Gleaner and across the trail from Slowdance boulder, the prow is found on the left while heading up the canyon.

boulders.name: Slow Dance Cave
boulders.approach: One of the first areas you come to on the approach. After hiking up the trail and entering the canyon, look for the large dark boulders on your right soon after the trail flattens out. The boulders are close and…

boulders.name: Totty Boulder
boulders.approach: As you walk up the main path into the canyon the path drops downhill for a short distance. This boulder is on your right at the base of the slope.

boulders.name: Coors Boulder
boulders.approach: across from the Split Melon boulder on the right

boulders.name: Safe Surfer Boulder
boulders.approach: Across from Heavenly Path Boulder

boulders.name: Split Melon Right Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder is located just off the main trail to the east between the Wavy Gravy and More Water Less Power areas. If you reach the distinctive slabby Heavenly Path boulder you've gone too far.

boulders.name: Timmy Taylor's Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the central valley and has you get towards the Heavenly Path boulder look left and you'll see this boulder about 20 yards away on your left.

boulders.name: Classique Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail head down to Tom Peter's Slab , and continue passed it to reach the East face of this boulder.

boulders.name: Grindrite Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail look back right and you'll see the prominent prow taken by Grindrite.

boulders.name: Non Such Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk from either Grindrite Boulder and Tom Peter's Slab .

boulders.name: Strange Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail turn off at the north end of the Tom Peters' Slab area. If you hit the Slow Dance area you've gone too far.

boulders.name: Sunburst Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk down to Classique Boulder and pass it and you'll come to this boulder.

boulders.name: Tom Peter's Slab
boulders.approach: Turn right of the main trail just as you come to Grindrite Boulder . The slab is located back on the right.

boulders.name: Wow Is Me Boulder
boulders.approach: You'll pass this boulder on your way to the better and taller Classique Boulder.

boulders.name: More Smack Boulders
boulders.approach: Walk down the main trail past the Slight Inducement Boulders. Look up to the right on the "rim". The More Smack Boulders can be found leaning against each other, separated by a crack.

boulders.name: Top Gun Boulders
boulders.approach: Just up-canyon from the More Smack and Wayko Boulders (north rim)

boulders.name: Wayko Boulder
boulders.approach: Up-canyon from Slight Inducement, and past the first small boulder-cluster just off the trail. The boulder pretty much hugs the trail on the right, just before the Top Gun Boulders.

boulders.name: Upper Canyon
boulders.approach: Once you have walked past the Top Gun Area on the main trail you have entered the 'Upper Canyon'.

boulders.name: BD Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the middle of the canyon to reach this boulder.

boulders.name: Fang Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the slope from the main area.

boulders.name: Slap Happy Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon, just after the small boulder is climbed over turn left and you'll be looking at the problems.

boulders.name: Wavy Gravy Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the middle of the canyon. Just as you approach a smooth boulder to climb up and over look left onto the Way Gravy Wall.

boulders.name: Big Arete Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk south from The Clapper Boulder to reach this block.

boulders.name: Clapper Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail hike up towards the west Rim and then follow it south until you reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Pig Pen Slab
boulders.approach: From the main trail hike up towards the West Rim and then follow it south until you reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Pokemon Boulder
boulders.approach: From the main trail hike up towards the west Rim and then follow it south until you reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Stache Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk through the gap between the clapper boulder and the pig pen slab.

boulders.name: Desert Skies/Morning Dove Area
boulders.approach: Walking up canyon, the West Rim is the rock band that runs along the entire left side of the canyon at the top of the hill. 'Desert Skies' is on the rim adjacent to the 'Happy Boulder Area'.

boulders.name: Hair Trigger Wall
boulders.approach: To the right of Highbrow Area Follow the main trail into the canyon and go left up the hillside from Corridor Boulder.

boulders.name: Highbrow Area
boulders.approach: From the main trail turn left shortly after passing the start of the bouldering. After a short walk the rim is reached. Follow the rim north to this area.

boulders.name: Southern Section
boulders.approach: From the main trail turn left shortly after passing the start of the bouldering. After a short walk this area is reached.

boulders.name: Work Wall
boulders.approach: Walk north from the approach path to reach this area. The left facing corner is at its right end and marks the end of the area.

boulders.name: Baroque Buttress
boulders.approach: Walk down into the cleft in the cliff. The wall is on your right.

boulders.name: Front Block
boulders.approach: Walk up to the are and this block is the first your will see.

boulders.name: The Hall of Mirrors
boulders.approach: Walk towards the rim, and turn left when you can.

boulders.name: King Louis
boulders.approach: Walk back towards the rim and this cliff is on the left.

boulders.name: Maximilien Buttress
boulders.approach: Walk up to the right of the blocking Front Block.

boulders.name: Captain Hook Alcove
boulders.approach: Walk north from the main wall.

boulders.name: Hand to Hand Combat Wall
boulders.approach: It is the next area you will hit just after the Sabres of Paradise Area. As you head up the canyon, you will come to a crossroads at the Gleanor Boulder. Going left will take you uphill to the Hand to Hand Combat Area…

boulders.name: Powis Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder is easily found at the left end of the area.

boulders.name: Sabres of Paradise
boulders.approach: Between Highbrow and Hand to Hand Combat.

boulders.name: Toxic Avenger Area
boulders.approach: Walk up the trail from Froz or approach from Desert Skies.

boulders.name: Birth of the Cool Area
boulders.approach: Hike up from the lower parking. Guantanamera is squeezed in between boulders and faces west. Guantanamera is on the South-west arete of the next boulder to the South.

boulders.name: Brown Slab
boulders.approach: Hike up from the Chalk Bluff Road parking lot. The boulder is on your left as you hike up the path.

boulders.name: Bruiser Boulder
boulders.approach: Lower Canyon above Bird Boulder

boulders.name: Central Joyless Area
boulders.approach: From the Molly Area head up the canyon 50 feet. The wall is on your left.

boulders.name: Death Star Cave
boulders.approach: From the Los Locos/Lawnmower Man Area, the cave is just down canyon, accessible from the same pit as Los Locos. Climb in and look for the chalk.

boulders.name: Dragon Cave
boulders.approach: From Los Locos, continue down the hill as if you were heading towards the Brown Slab, but cut right about halfway there. See picture for what you are looking for.

boulders.name: Extrapolator Area
boulders.approach: This boulder is about an eight minute walk uphill from "Los Locos" and is hidden along the rim and may be worth finding before hiking pads up.

boulders.name: Pocket Traverse Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Los Locos Area hike east and uphill and the pocketed north face of this boulder can be seen.

boulders.name: Greg's Place
boulders.approach: It is located just below the top of the east hillside of the canyon.

boulders.name: Hidden Roof Area
boulders.approach: Skirt the southern end of the Brown Slab Boulder, going past the entrance to the Pinball cave. Navigate the talus to find yourself at a slab that will bring you up and into the Gollum Cave, then exit that problem and…

boulders.name: Humpty Dumpty Area
boulders.approach: Hike west of the Brown Slab boulder.

boulders.name: Ice Caves
boulders.approach: Located just east of the upper parking lot.

boulders.name: Chef's Boulder - East Side
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon. At the dead end look left and you'll be facing this boulder.

boulders.name: Crack Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon and as you enter the area look right and you'll see a slanting crack.

boulders.name: Eastern Rim
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon, when the walls close in move rightwards to reach the scoop.

boulders.name: Emma's Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon, and just before the northern access path you'll find this boulder.

boulders.name: Hauck a Loogie Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon into the area and just passed the path from the upper parking lot look left. You'll be staring at this rock.

boulders.name: The Hot Pants Boulder
boulders.approach: Located at the north section of the area. It faces you as you walk up the canyon.

boulders.name: Short Arete Boulders
boulders.approach: Walk up the canyon and just before the northern access path enters the canyon you'll see the boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Shorty Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up canyon to just the northern access path entrance. The boulder is located on the right.

boulders.name: Beano Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot, head up and to the left towards the rim. As you approach the rim you'll be facing the east face of this boulder.

boulders.name: Mr Frosty Cave
boulders.approach: From the parking lot walk south a few yards, and at the first opportunity walk up between boulders then head right into the corral.

boulders.name: Parking Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot walk along the road for 10 yards, then turn left.

boulders.name: Psycho Billy Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot head up right towards the rim. This boulder is situated on the left as you near the rim.

boulders.name: Rim Job Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot head up right towards the rim. You'll see the distinctive overhanging face on the right.

boulders.name: Slunk Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking area, scramble up and left towards the rim.

boulders.name: Tim's Highball Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder lies 100 yards south from the parking lot along the edge of the escarpment.

boulders.name: Big Kipper Boulder
boulders.approach: From the approach trail, take the first left down into the canyon.

boulders.name: Big Slab Boulder
boulders.approach: This large boulder is located on the trail at the very peak of the talus slope.

boulders.name: Boneless Herring Boulder
boulders.approach: From the lower parking lot, take the trail to the very top of the hill, and follow the first foot path into the valley. Trend leftward into the alcove.

boulders.name: Cow Skull Boulder
boulders.approach: Just down canyon from Rio's Crack

boulders.name: Kung-Fu Grip Boulder
boulders.approach: Just north of the Big Slab.

boulders.name: Space Suit Boulder
boulders.approach: This suspended block is easily visible from the trial that runs along the East rim.

boulders.name: Los Locos Area
boulders.approach: Just down canyon from the 'Molly Area', the main trail gets more confusing in this area. As you hop over boulders 'Lawnmower Man' will be up to the west and 'Los Locos' will be down in a pit to the left as you head down…

boulders.name: Flake Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder lies uphill east of the Misery boulder.

boulders.name: Misery Cave
boulders.approach: Just south of Pow Pow you can duck (left) into a corridor that leads to a room formed by the West face of the Misery boulder.

boulders.name: Misery Cave North Entrance
boulders.approach: Drop down into the area and before ducking to enter the cave, stop.

boulders.name: White House Wall
boulders.approach: Walk past Flake Boulder to find a wall uphill and to the left of "The Arete".

boulders.name: Molly Area
boulders.approach: Down canyon from 'Pow Pow Area', the Molly Boulder's prime side faces west. The main trail goes right by it, and it'll be on your right if facing up-canyon. The near vertical face hosts pockets and edges and there's a…

boulders.name: Pow Pow Alcove
boulders.approach: About 100 yards south of the upper parking.

boulders.name: Sun Spot Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk along the canyon and when in the middle of the area look east and you'll be facing this boulder.

boulders.name: Water Colors Alcove
boulders.approach: Located up behind Pow Pow Alcove .

boulders.name: Bomber Boulders
boulders.approach: The right most section of this area.

boulders.name: Crystal Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach bluffs North-east of the upper parking (toward the White Mountains).

boulders.name: Jerry Falwell Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up canyon to almost its end and you'll be close to this boulder.

boulders.name: Pop-a-Wheelie Boulder
boulders.approach: Along the rim, just slightly North-east of the Ice Caves Area.

boulders.name: Prozac Nation Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach bluffs North-east of the upper parking (toward the White Mountains).

boulders.name: The Snapper Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder/bluff lies north of Pop-a-Wheelie.

boulders.name: Talk Talk Boulder
boulders.approach: From the upper parking lot walk towards the other side of the canyon. You'll hit this boulder.

boulders.name: Valium Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk upslope from Talk Talk Boulder towards the canyon rim.

boulders.name: Rio's Crack Area
boulders.approach: Just down canyon from the Los Locos area and on the western rim of the canyon. Look for the north facing wall with the nice left slanting seam on the left side of the wall. It is tucked up behind some other boulders…

boulders.name: Bertie Blunt
boulders.approach: From the Parrot Fashion Boulder , head through the rock arch and you'll be at the bottom of the boulder.

boulders.name: The Bird Cage Boulder
boulders.approach: From the center canyon follow the path up the east slope from the Pow Pow Area . The boulder is soon reached.

boulders.name: Norwegian Blue Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is on the eastern rim facing the Parrot Fashion Boulder .

boulders.name: Parrot Fashion Boulder
boulders.approach: Head up and left from The Bird Cage Boulder and after about 20 yards you'll be at the bottom.

boulders.name: Sad Parrot Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk up the slope to the center of the area, and you'll come to this boulder on the right as you approach the eastern rim.

boulders.name: South Arete Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder is found about 30 yards south along the edge from the main area.

boulders.name: Power of Numbers
boulders.approach: Located on the west side of the path.

boulders.name: Strength in Numbers
boulders.approach: Just south of the Ice Caves, the large boulder with the tempting overhanging face on its north side. The boulder sits just off the trail on the right if walking up-canyon.

problems.name: This Side of Paradise
problems.where: On the West side of the boulder.

problems.name: The Beautiful and Damned
problems.where: North-East side of the boulder.

problems.name: A Maze of Death
problems.where: On the East face of the boulder.

videos.t: Bishop Bouldering: A Maze of Death (V12)

problems.name: Rex Kwon Do
problems.where: The unmistakable arete climb on the boulder.

problems.name: Psyche Transfer Recieved
problems.where: This is the beautiful slightly overhanging patina covered SE face.

problems.name: Psyche Transfer sent
problems.where: Same start as for "Psyche Transfer Recieved"

problems.name: Flight of the Bumblebee
problems.where: Left of "The Swarm", about exactly in the middle of the Brown Wall/ Titan Boulder.

problems.name: The Swarm Direct
problems.where: The right side of the Brown Wall.

problems.name: Form Destroyer
problems.where: This route is located on the left side of the boulder (when approaching from downhill) on an overhanging roof.

problems.name: The Form
problems.where: On the backside of the block. When looking downhill at the large face this problem will start slightly left of a plant.

problems.name: Xenolith Dyno-soar
